note: Superior NF rustic campground on Wilson Lake (about 650 acres), about 14 mi of forest roads inland from Highway 61 near Schroeder via FR 343, 166, 346, 170 and 355, with a drive-down boat ramp and dock; the sites sit in the woods west of the ramp. No garbage service, so everything is packed out; roads are not plowed in winter. Pad lengths are not posted beyond the forest's 'longer than 21 feet'. The two backcountry sites on Wilson and Little Wilson lakes are separate. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 4 car-accessible pull-in sites (three longer than 21 ft 'may accommodate an RV'), vault toilet, no drinking water, no fee, May 8-Oct 1, no rec.gov listing (first come).
